integrity: The recent source was read in full arXiv HTML. Lemma 6 identifies \(\mathbf G(\alpha)\) with \(R_\alpha\subseteq R\); Lemma 5 fixes the word-to-relation composition convention; Example 7 supplies standard examples but not the complete length-two implication poset. The six finite witness frames were independently recomputed by the included checker. MSC2020 places modal logic under 03B45, matching the objects and frame semantics used here.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to single generalized path conditions generated by words of length at most \(2\). It does not classify longer words, conjunctions of GPCs, or metatheoretic properties of the resulting calculi.
title: Length-two generalized path conditions form a six-way antichain
